title: Three Kingdoms 7: The Battle of Red Cliffs  (Part One)

series.title: Three Kingdoms 7: The Battle of Red Cliffs  (Part One)

fullText.simplified:
第1章、船和水仗

    现在是十一月，南方的天气变冷了。
    荆州和江东中间是长江。长江的西北边是荆州，东南边是江东。现在，曹操的军队住在江的西北边，几十万多人和几千条战船把长江的冬天变热闹了。
    曹操一直认为南方没有多少军队，也没有什么厉害的将军，他很快就能拿下南方，但他只想对了一半——荆州是这样的，江东不是。荆州之主刘从没有打就投降了，江东之主孙权不但没有投降，还和刘备站在了一起。
    好吧，不投降那就打吧！江东只有五六万人，曹操有八十多万人，这场仗可以很快就结束。这是曹操的想法，但事情真的和他想的一样吗？
    曹操从北方出来已经五个多月了，出发的时候他的军队穿着夏天的衣服，现在是冬天了，要穿冬天的衣服了。冬天的衣服是从北方送过来的，路很远，时间有点儿长，有些人很晚才拿到衣服，这时候他们已经病了。还有些人因为出来打仗的时间太长，身体太累，也生病了。当然，还有一个更重要的原因——船。
    曹操的军队几乎都是北方人，很少坐船，所以都不太适应坐船。但和江东打的是水仗，不但要坐船，还要会开船。现在江边的七千多条战船上都住着曹操的兵，江很大，水很深，水浪拍打着船底，住在船上的兵很不适应，很多人生病了。
    因为生病的人太多，所以不能马上打江东，这是曹操没有想到的。现在，军队里没有生病的人只有二十多万，这些都是投降的荆州兵。荆州兵和江东兵一样，都是在江边长大的，早就见过长江的大风大浪。这些荆州兵的将军也是荆州人，名字叫蔡帽。
    虽然蔡帽也投降了曹操，但曹操还是不太相信他。因为曹操觉得投降的荆州将军和荆州之主刘从一样，都是胆小的人。但没有办法，曹操没有会开战船、打水仗的将军，和江东的这场仗，他还需要蔡帽。
    蔡帽每天带着北方来的兵在江边练习，告诉他们怎样开战船和怎样在船上生活。曹操经常到江边来看，他看了几天，心情终于好一些了。
fullText.traditional:
第1章、船和水仗

    現在是十一月，南方的天氣變冷了。
    荊州和江東中間是長江。長江的西北邊是荊州，東南邊是江東。現在，曹操的軍隊住在江的西北邊，幾十萬多人和幾千條戰船把長江的冬天變熱鬧了。
    曹操一直認為南方沒有多少軍隊，也沒有什麼厲害的將軍，他很快就能拿下南方，但他只想對了一半——荊州是這樣的，江東不是。荊州之主劉從沒有打就投降了，江東之主孫權不但沒有投降，還和劉備站在了一起。
    好吧，不投降那就打吧！江東只有五六萬人，曹操有八十多萬人，這場仗可以很快就結束。這是曹操的想法，但事情真的和他想的一樣嗎？
    曹操從北方出來已經五個多月了，出發的時候他的軍隊穿著夏天的衣服，現在是冬天了，要穿冬天的衣服了。冬天的衣服是從北方送過來的，路很遠，時間有點兒長，有些人很晚才拿到衣服，這時候他們已經病了。還有些人因為出來打仗的時間太長，身體太累，也生病了。當然，還有一個更重要的原因——船。
    曹操的軍隊幾乎都是北方人，很少坐船，所以都不太適應坐船。但和江東打的是水仗，不但要坐船，還要會開船。現在江邊的七千多條戰船上都住著曹操的兵，江很大，水很深，水浪拍打著船底，住在船上的兵很不適應，很多人生病了。
    因為生病的人太多，所以不能馬上打江東，這是曹操沒有想到的。現在，軍隊裡沒有生病的人只有二十多萬，這些都是投降的荊州兵。荊州兵和江東兵一樣，都是在江邊長大的，早就見過長江的大風大浪。這些荊州兵的將軍也是荊州人，名字叫蔡㡌。
    雖然蔡㡌也投降了曹操，但曹操還是不太相信他。因為曹操覺得投降的荊州將軍和荊州之主劉從一樣，都是膽小的人。但沒有辦法，曹操沒有會開戰船、打水仗的將軍，和江東的這場仗，他還需要蔡㡌。
    蔡㡌每天帶著北方來的兵在江邊練習，告訴他們怎樣開戰船和怎樣在船上生活。曹操經常到江邊來看，他看了幾天，心情終於好一些了。

sentences.simplified: 现在是十一月，南方的天气变冷了。
sentences.traditional: 現在是十一月，南方的天氣變冷了。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài shì shí yī yuè nán fāng de tiān qì biàn lěng le
sentences.english: It was November, and it was getting cold in the south.

sentences.simplified: 荆州和江东中间是长江。
sentences.traditional: 荊州和江東中間是長江。
sentences.pinyin: jīng zhōu hé jiāng dōng zhōng jiān shì cháng jiāng
sentences.english: The Yangtze River is between Jingzhou and Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 长江的西北边是荆州，东南边是江东。
sentences.traditional: 長江的西北邊是荊州，東南邊是江東。
sentences.pinyin: cháng jiāng de xī běi biān shì jīng zhōu dōng nán biān shì jiāng dōng
sentences.english: To the northwest of the Yangtze River is Jingzhou, and to the southeast is Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 现在，曹操的军队住在江的西北边，
sentences.traditional: 現在，曹操的軍隊住在江的西北邊，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài cáo cāo de jūn duì zhù zài jiāng de xī běi biān
sentences.english: Cao Cao’s troops were staying on the northwest side of the river.

sentences.simplified: 几十万多人和几千条战船把长江的冬天变热闹了。
sentences.traditional: 幾十萬多人和幾千條戰船把長江的冬天變熱鬧了。
sentences.pinyin: jǐ shí wàn duō rén hé jǐ qiān tiáo zhàn chuán bǎ cháng jiāng de dōng tiān biàn rè nao le
sentences.english: Hundreds of thousands of men and several thousand war boats made winter on the Yangtze River bustle with noise and excitement.

sentences.simplified: 曹操一直认为南方没有多少军队，也没有什么厉害的将军，他很快就能拿下南方，
sentences.traditional: 曹操一直認為南方沒有多少軍隊，也沒有什麼厲害的將軍，他很快就能拿下南方，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo yì zhí rèn wéi nán fāng méi yǒu duō shǎo jūn duì yě méi yǒu shén me lì hai de jiāng jūn tā hěn kuài jiù néng ná xià nán fāng
sentences.english: Cao Cao had always thought that the south had few troops and no formidable generals and that he would soon take the south.

sentences.simplified: 但他只想对了一半——荆州是这样的，江东不是。
sentences.traditional: 但他只想對了一半——荊州是這樣的，江東不是。
sentences.pinyin: dàn tā zhǐ xiǎng duì le yí bàn jīng zhōu shì zhè yàng de jiāng dōng bú shì
sentences.english: But he was only half right—Jingzhou was like that, but Jiangdong was not.

sentences.simplified: 荆州之主刘从没有打就投降了，
sentences.traditional: 荊州之主劉從沒有打就投降了，
sentences.pinyin: jīng zhōu zhī zhǔ liú cóng méi yǒu dǎ jiù tóu xiáng le
sentences.english: The master of Jingzhou, Liu Cong, surrendered without fighting.

sentences.simplified: 江东之主孙权不但没有投降，还和刘备站在了一起。
sentences.traditional: 江東之主孫權不但沒有投降，還和劉備站在了一起。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng zhī zhǔ sūn quán bú dàn méi yǒu tóu xiáng hái hé liú bèi zhàn zài le yì qǐ
sentences.english: The master of Jingzhou, Sun Quan, not only did not surrender but also stood with Liu Bei.

sentences.simplified: 好吧，不投降那就打吧！
sentences.traditional: 好吧，不投降那就打吧！
sentences.pinyin: hǎo ba bù tóu xiáng nà jiù dǎ ba
sentences.english: Fine, if he won’t surrender, then let’s fight!

sentences.simplified: 江东只有五六万人，曹操有八十多万人，这场仗可以很快就结束。
sentences.traditional: 江東只有五六萬人，曹操有八十多萬人，這場仗可以很快就結束。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng zhǐ yǒu wǔ liù wàn rén cáo cāo yǒu bā shí duō wàn rén zhè cháng zhàng kě yǐ hěn kuài jiù jié shù
sentences.english: Jiangdong only has 50,000 or 60,000 men. Cao Cao has more than 800,000 men. This war can end very quickly.

sentences.simplified: 这是曹操的想法，但事情真的和他想的一样吗？
sentences.traditional: 這是曹操的想法，但事情真的和他想的一樣嗎？
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì cáo cāo de xiǎng fǎ dàn shì qing zhēn de hé tā xiǎng de yí yàng ma
sentences.english: This was what Cao Cao thought, but were things really as he imagined?

sentences.simplified: 曹操从北方出来已经五个多月了，
sentences.traditional: 曹操從北方出來已經五個多月了，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo cóng běi fāng chū lái yǐ jīng wǔ ge duō yuè le
sentences.english: It had already been five months since Cao Cao had come out from the north.

sentences.simplified: 出发的时候他的军队穿着夏天的衣服，现在是冬天了，要穿冬天的衣服了。
sentences.traditional: 出發的時候他的軍隊穿著夏天的衣服，現在是冬天了，要穿冬天的衣服了。
sentences.pinyin: chū fā de shí hou tā de jūn duì chuān zhe xià tiān de yī fu xiàn zài shì dōng tiān le yào chuān dōng tiān de yī fu le
sentences.english: When the troops departed, they were still wearing summer clothing. Now it was winter, and they had to wear winter clothing.

sentences.simplified: 冬天的衣服是从北方送过来的，路很远，时间有点儿长，
sentences.traditional: 冬天的衣服是從北方送過來的，路很遠，時間有點兒長，
sentences.pinyin: dōng tiān de yī fu shì cóng běi fāng sòng guò lái de lù hěn yuǎn shí jiān yǒu diǎn'r cháng
sentences.english: The winter clothing was sent down from the north. It was a long distance, and it took quite a long time.

sentences.simplified: 有些人很晚才拿到衣服，这时候他们已经病了。
sentences.traditional: 有些人很晚才拿到衣服，這時候他們已經病了。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē rén hěn wǎn cái ná dào yī fu zhè shí hou tā men yǐ jīng bìng le
sentences.english: Some of the men received their clothing very late, and by that time, they had already gotten sick.

sentences.simplified: 还有些人因为出来打仗的时间太长，身体太累，也生病了。
sentences.traditional: 還有些人因為出來打仗的時間太長，身體太累，也生病了。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu xiē rén yīn wèi chū lái dǎ zhàng de shí jiān tài cháng shēn tǐ tài lèi yě shēng bìng le
sentences.english: Other men had become tired and also gotten sick because they had been out fighting for too long.

sentences.simplified: 当然，还有一个更重要的原因——船。
sentences.traditional: 當然，還有一個更重要的原因——船。
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán hái yǒu yí ge gèng zhòng yào de yuán yīn chuán
sentences.english: Of course, there was also another more important reason—boats.

sentences.simplified: 曹操的军队几乎都是北方人，很少坐船，所以都不太适应坐船。
sentences.traditional: 曹操的軍隊幾乎都是北方人，很少坐船，所以都不太適應坐船。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo de jūn duì jī hū dōu shì běi fāng rén hěn shǎo zuò chuán suǒ yǐ dōu bú tài shì yìng zuò chuán
sentences.english: Cao Cao’s troops were almost all northerners who rarely rode on boats. So, they were not used to riding on boats.

sentences.simplified: 但和江东打的是水仗，不但要坐船，还要会开船。
sentences.traditional: 但和江東打的是水仗，不但要坐船，還要會開船。
sentences.pinyin: dàn hé jiāng dōng dǎ de shì shuǐ zhàng bú dàn yào zuò chuán hái yào huì kāi chuán
sentences.english: However, to fight Jiangdong in a naval battle, not only must they ride on boats, but they must also be able to drive the boats.

sentences.simplified: 现在江边的七千多条战船上都住着曹操的兵，
sentences.traditional: 現在江邊的七千多條戰船上都住著曹操的兵，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài jiāng biān de qī qiān duō tiáo zhàn chuán shang dōu zhù zhe cáo cāo de bīng
sentences.english: The 7,000 or so war boats on the banks of the river all housed Cao Cao’s troops.

sentences.simplified: 江很大，水很深，水浪拍打着船底，
sentences.traditional: 江很大，水很深，水浪拍打著船底，
sentences.pinyin: jiāng hěn dà shuǐ hěn shēn shuǐ làng pāi da zhe chuán dǐ
sentences.english: The river was very big, the water was very deep, and the waves struck the bottom of the boats.

sentences.simplified: 住在船上的兵很不适应，很多人生病了。
sentences.traditional: 住在船上的兵很不適應，很多人生病了。
sentences.pinyin: zhù zài chuán shang de bīng hěn bú shì yìng hěn duō rén shēng bìng le
sentences.english: The troops who lived on the boats were not used to it, and many men got sick.

sentences.simplified: 因为生病的人太多，所以不能马上打江东，
sentences.traditional: 因為生病的人太多，所以不能馬上打江東，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi shēng bìng de rén tài duō suǒ yǐ bù néng mǎ shàng dǎ jiāng dōng
sentences.english: Because too many men got sick, they couldn’t immediately fight Jiangdong.

sentences.simplified: 这是曹操没有想到的。
sentences.traditional: 這是曹操沒有想到的。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì cáo cāo méi yǒu xiǎng dào de
sentences.english: This is something that Cao Cao had not considered.

sentences.simplified: 现在，军队里没有生病的人只有二十多万，这些都是投降的荆州兵。
sentences.traditional: 現在，軍隊裡沒有生病的人只有二十多萬，這些都是投降的荊州兵。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài jūn duì lǐ méi yǒu shēng bìng de rén zhǐ yǒu èr shí duō wàn zhè xiē dōu shì tóu xiáng de jīng zhōu bīng
sentences.english: There were now only 200,000 or so men who hadn’t gotten sick. These men were all Jingzhou soldiers who had surrendered.

sentences.simplified: 荆州兵和江东兵一样，都是在江边长大的，
sentences.traditional: 荊州兵和江東兵一樣，都是在江邊長大的，
sentences.pinyin: jīng zhōu bīng hé jiāng dōng bīng yí yàng dōu shì zài jiāng biān zhǎng dà de
sentences.english: Like the soldiers from Jiangdong, the soldiers from Jingzhou grew up on the banks of the river.

sentences.simplified: 早就见过长江的大风大浪。
sentences.traditional: 早就見過長江的大風大浪。
sentences.pinyin: zǎo jiù jiàn guò cháng jiāng de dà fēng dà làng
sentences.english: They had already seen the strong winds and big waves of the Yangtze River long ago.

sentences.simplified: 这些荆州兵的将军也是荆州人，名字叫蔡帽。
sentences.traditional: 這些荊州兵的將軍也是荊州人，名字叫蔡㡌。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē jīng zhōu bīng de jiāng jūn yě shì jīng zhōu rén míng zi jiào cài mào
sentences.english: The general of these Jingzhou soldiers was also from Jingzhou. His name was Cai Mao.

sentences.simplified: 虽然蔡帽也投降了曹操，但曹操还是不太相信他。
sentences.traditional: 雖然蔡㡌也投降了曹操，但曹操還是不太相信他。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán cài mào yě tóu xiáng le cáo cāo dàn cáo cāo hái shi bú tài xiāng xìn tā
sentences.english: Although Cai Mao also surrendered to Cao Cao, Cao Cao still didn’t really trust him.

sentences.simplified: 因为曹操觉得投降的荆州将军和荆州之主刘从一样，都是胆小的人。
sentences.traditional: 因為曹操覺得投降的荊州將軍和荊州之主劉從一樣，都是膽小的人。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi cáo cāo jué de tóu xiáng de jīng zhōu jiāng jūn hé jīng zhōu zhī zhǔ liú cóng yí yàng dōu shì dǎn xiǎo de rén
sentences.english: Because Cao Cao thought that the Jingzhou general who surrendered to him was a coward, like the master of Jingzhou, Liu Cong.

sentences.simplified: 但没有办法，曹操没有会开战船、打水仗的将军，
sentences.traditional: 但沒有辦法，曹操沒有會開戰船、打水仗的將軍，
sentences.pinyin: dàn méi yǒu bàn fǎ cáo cāo méi yǒu huì kāi zhàn chuán dǎ shuǐ zhàng de jiāng jūn
sentences.english: But he had no choice. Cao Cao didn’t have a general who could drive war boats and fight naval battles.

sentences.simplified: 和江东的这场仗，他还需要蔡帽。
sentences.traditional: 和江東的這場仗，他還需要蔡㡌。
sentences.pinyin: hé jiāng dōng de zhè cháng zhàng tā hái xū yào cài mào
sentences.english: For this war with Jiangdong, he still needed Cai Mao.

sentences.simplified: 蔡帽每天带着北方来的兵在江边练习，
sentences.traditional: 蔡㡌每天帶著北方來的兵在江邊練習，
sentences.pinyin: cài mào měi tiān dài zhe běi fāng lái de bīng zài jiāng biān liàn xí
sentences.english: Cai Mao led the soldiers from the north to the banks of the river to practice.

sentences.simplified: 告诉他们怎样开战船和怎样在船上生活。
sentences.traditional: 告訴他們怎樣開戰船和怎樣在船上生活。
sentences.pinyin: gào su tā men zěn yàng kāi zhàn chuán hé zěn yàng zài chuán shang shēng huó
sentences.english: He told them how to drive war boats and how to live on boats.

sentences.simplified: 曹操经常到江边来看，他看了几天，心情终于好一些了。
sentences.traditional: 曹操經常到江邊來看，他看了幾天，心情終於好一些了。

sentence_translations: Chapter 1: Boats and Naval Warfare
It was November, and it was getting cold in the south.
The Yangtze River is between Jingzhou and Jiangdong.
To the northwest of the Yangtze River is Jingzhou, and to the southeast is Jiangdong.
Cao Cao’s troops were staying on the northwest side of the river.
Hundreds of thousands of men and several thousand war boats made winter on the Yangtze River bustle with noise and excitement.
Cao Cao had always thought that the south had few troops and no formidable generals and that he would soon take the south.
But he was only half right—Jingzhou was like that, but Jiangdong was not.
The master of Jingzhou, Liu Cong, surrendered without fighting.
The master of Jingzhou, Sun Quan, not only did not surrender but also stood with Liu Bei.
Fine, if he won’t surrender, then let’s fight!
Jiangdong only has 50,000 or 60,000 men. Cao Cao has more than 800,000 men. This war can end very quickly.
This was what Cao Cao thought, but were things really as he imagined?
It had already been five months since Cao Cao had come out from the north.
When the troops departed, they were still wearing summer clothing. Now it was winter, and they had to wear winter clothing.
The winter clothing was sent down from the north. It was a long distance, and it took quite a long time.
Some of the men received their clothing very late, and by that time, they had already gotten sick.
Other men had become tired and also gotten sick because they had been out fighting for too long.
Of course, there was also another more important reason—boats.
Cao Cao’s troops were almost all northerners who rarely rode on boats. So, they were not used to riding on boats.
However, to fight Jiangdong in a naval battle, not only must they ride on boats, but they must also be able to drive the boats.
The 7,000 or so war boats on the banks of the river all housed Cao Cao’s troops.
The river was very big, the water was very deep, and the waves struck the bottom of the boats.
The troops who lived on the boats were not used to it, and many men got sick.
Because too many men got sick, they couldn’t immediately fight Jiangdong.
This is something that Cao Cao had not considered.
There were now only 200,000 or so men who hadn’t gotten sick. These men were all Jingzhou soldiers who had surrendered.
Like the soldiers from Jiangdong, the soldiers from Jingzhou grew up on the banks of the river.
They had already seen the strong winds and big waves of the Yangtze River long ago.
The general of these Jingzhou soldiers was also from Jingzhou. His name was Cai Mao.
Although Cai Mao also surrendered to Cao Cao, Cao Cao still didn’t really trust him.
Because Cao Cao thought that the Jingzhou general who surrendered to him was a coward, like the master of Jingzhou, Liu Cong.
But he had no choice. Cao Cao didn’t have a general who could drive war boats and fight naval battles.
For this war with Jiangdong, he still needed Cai Mao.
Cai Mao led the soldiers from the north to the banks of the river to practice.
He told them how to drive war boats and how to live on boats.
Cao Cao often came to the bank of the river to watch. He watched for a few days and finally felt a little more at ease.
